headline: US midterm results start arriving this morning Bangkok time, Binance says deposits now beat withdrawals after its hack, and bitcoin sits near $77,000.

stories.title: Midterm results start tonight, with crypto's market bill at stake
stories.summary: Americans voted on Tuesday for control of Congress. The result shapes whether the CLARITY Act, the US crypto market-structure bill, can still pass. Prediction markets favour Democrats, and the first polls close at 06:00 Wednesday Bangkok time.
points: Polymarket at 19:01 UTC priced Democratic control at 95 cents for the House and 75 cents for the Senate, per TS2.
Earlier on Tuesday, Kalshi gave Democrats 76% and Polymarket 77% to control the Senate, per Forbes.
The CLARITY Act passed the House 294-134 in July 2025, failed a Senate procedural vote 49-50 on 15 Sept, and dies if not passed before 3 Jan, per Bitcoin Magazine.
TD Cowen sees a Democratic sweep as the least favourable outcome for crypto, per Bitcoin Magazine.
First polls close at 6:00pm ET (06:00 Wed Bangkok), the biggest wave at 8:00pm ET (08:00 Wed Bangkok), and the last, in Alaska, at 1:00am ET (13:00 Wed Bangkok), per Universal Time Date.

stories.title: Binance: deposits now beat withdrawals after the $6.34B hack
stories.summary: After days of heavy withdrawals, money is flowing back into Binance on a net basis, and its co-CEO says flows have pretty much normalized. Binance's report says North Korean hackers got in through a fake job interview and a tampered software package. North Korea calls the US allegation absurd.
points: DefiLlama shows about $2.3B of net inflows to Binance over the past 24 hours, after more than $7B of net outflows on Monday, per Cointelegraph (3 Nov).
Binance says net customer withdrawals were $4.72B as of 2 Nov, about 3% of platform assets, per Reuters via GMA News.
About $2.85B has been frozen or intercepted, per The Block. Sources differ on how much has been replaced: 98% per The Block, 95% per co-CEO Richard Teng speaking to Reuters.
Binance warns that anyone offering to speed up withdrawals for a fee is a scammer, per Cointelegraph.
Kim Yo Jong called the US allegations "absurd rhetoric", per KCNA via GMA News.

stories.title: Bitcoin holds near $77,000 as options traders pay up for the election
stories.summary: Bitcoin dipped to about $76,300 in the European morning on Tuesday and was circling $77,000 by 15:44 UTC. US spot bitcoin funds lost about $399M on Monday, their second straight day of outflows, and options prices show traders expect bigger moves around the election.
points: Spot bitcoin ETFs: -$398.6M on 2 Nov; BlackRock's IBIT -$405.3M, Fidelity's FBTC +$6.68M, per crypto.news.
IBIT's outflow was its largest since June, per CoinDesk citing Farside.
Near-dated bitcoin implied volatility rose to about 51% from about 43.5%, which CoinDesk calls an election premium.
Liquidations over 24 hours were $382.6M, per CoinDesk.
Bitcoin was circling $77,000, up about 0.7% on Tuesday, per Cointelegraph (15:44 UTC).

briefs.title: CFTC clears perpetual futures on US stocks
briefs.summary: CFTC Chair Selig said "equity perps" are deemed approved as security futures under joint CFTC and SEC oversight; no exchanges or launch date were named, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: South Korea tells exchanges to hold more in cold wallets
briefs.summary: After the Binance hack, South Korea's Financial Services Commission told local exchanges to keep more funds offline and tighten withdrawal controls; the legal minimum is 80%, per Cointelegraph.

briefs.title: Suspected theft from an EU firm raised to $133M
briefs.summary: ZachXBT raised his estimate from $106M and says about $30.5M has already been moved; the victim is not confirmed, per Cointelegraph.

briefs.title: Mercado Bitcoin says it will refund users after hack
briefs.summary: Brazil's largest exchange puts its loss at about $38M and has blocked $11M with Tether, Circle and Paxos; deposits and withdrawals are still paused, per Decrypt.

briefs.title: Coinbase stock bounces after Morgan Stanley downgrade
briefs.summary: COIN rose 5.84% to $145.89 at 10:31am ET on Tuesday, a day after Morgan Stanley told investors to steer clear of the stock, per 24/7 Wall St citing CNBC.

briefs.title: Liquid's bitcoin token fully backed again
briefs.summary: Blockstream paid in the last 550 BTC, restoring full backing for Liquid's LBTC after the 6 Sep exploit of about 4,000 BTC, per The Block.

briefs.title: Strategy buys 811 more bitcoin
briefs.summary: Strategy bought 811 BTC for $65.5M in the week to 1 Nov, taking its holdings to 849,327 BTC at an average cost of $75,451, per The Block.

briefs.title: NEAR votes to cut new token issuance
briefs.summary: NEAR governance approved lowering the yearly issuance ceiling from 2.5% to 1.6% over 24 months, per The Block.
